Mining Engine & Capital Upgrades

24H Proof-of-Activity & Upgrade Policy

The 24-Hour Mining Engine Workflow:

STEP 1: STOPPED

Purchase State

Node starts in STOPPED (Red) state. 0 yield credited until daily manual activation.

STEP 2: ACTIVE

Emerald Core

Tap 'Start Mining'. Core glows EMERALD GREEN with active 24-hour countdown timer.

STEP 3: SETTLED

Wallet Credit

At 24:00:00, daily earnings settle to your wallet, core resets to Red for next cycle.

⚠️

Missed Days Rule: You must activate your mining core daily. If you miss activating on any day, zero (0) yield is credited for that missed cycle.

Difference-Only Plan Upgrade Architecture:

Never Pay Full Price to Upgrade!

When upgrading to a higher node tier, your existing active plan capital is deducted from the new tier price, and you pay ONLY the exact difference:

$20 ➔ $50 (Cryptera)
Pay $30 Only
$50 ➔ $150 (Novacore)
Pay $100 Only
$150 ➔ $350 (Hypervex)
Pay $200 Only
